# Language Variety

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageVariety`](gmeow-LanguageVariety.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageVariety>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

A speech variety that carries names, scripts, tags, status, provenance, and alignment metadata exactly as a [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md) does, because it IS a language (a SubKind). Classifications such as dialect, sociolect, register, or standard are standpointed claims via [`gmeow:varietyKind`](../properties/gmeow-varietyKind.md), not OWL subclass decisions — so a single variety can be classified as a language by one standpoint and a dialect by another without incoherence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageVariety`](gmeow-LanguageVariety.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
